thread:
maya: :rotating_light: Seeing a spike of timeouts and 502/504s from gateway starting ~09:20 UTC. Dashboards show error rate jumping from 0.2% -> ~6% and p99 latency for generation routes up 3x.
ben: Which routes? any common model or client?
maya: Mostly /v1/generate and our embed endpoint. Higher seq-length requests failing more often.
incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED by maya at 2026-03-14T09:22:10Z — Status: investigating. Paging on-call.
ben: paging @sophie (oncall). Sophie — can you take pager?
sophie: on it. I see gateway logs with lots of `upstream timeout` and `connection reset`. There are also a ton of dropped requests in the edge ingress. No obvious CPU/GPU saturation on serving nodes.
ryan: I can watch infra metrics — CPU/GPU fine, but the gateway pod OOMs a few minutes ago and restarted on one zone. Could be connection handling or burst queues.
maya: also: traces are sparse. We only have sampling at 1% for production, so most of these failures lack spans. That makes root cause hard.
ben: Ugh. Observability gap. Can we bump sampling for the affected routes? Short-term: increase tracer sampling to 20% for routes matching `/v1/generate` and `/v1/embed`. Long-term follow-up will be to change default for error responses.
sophie: Doing that now — patching trace sampler via config API. Also enabling access logs at edge for gateway pods so we can correlate request IDs -> upstream.
maya: Problem: many requests are missing request_id header because clients sometimes omit it. Our gateway tries to synthesize one but it's not being emitted into downstream logs. Need stopgap to inject X-Request-Id into all access logs and into upstream proxied requests.
ryan: I can push an Envoy config hotpatch to enable `x-request-id` generation and to add `%REQ(X-REQUEST-ID)%` into access_log format. Command: `kubectl -n redwood exec -it gateway-ctrl -- envoy-config-rollout --hotpatch` (running it now).
ops-bot: rollout started: envoy-config-rollout/gateway/2026-03-14-0928 — 3/3 pods updated.
ben: parallel mitigation: reduce burst queue at gateway to limit head-of-line blocking; set `max_concurrent_streams` lower for upstreams to protect model-backends. Also enable short-circuit fallback to lighter model variant for slow requests.
sophie: Applying stream limits and adding fallback route — config pushed to staging then prod. Monitoring now.
maya: Quick customer impact estimate: ~8% of production requests retried by clients, some timed out client-side. A small set of enterprise customers saw errors on long-chained generation calls; CS alerted two customers.
ben: Notify CS with preliminary impact: percentage, affected endpoints, ETA for mitigation. I'll draft note.
ryan: Observability gap follow-ups I'm logging: 1) default trace sampling too low for error conditions, 2) request-id not consistently emitted, 3) access logs missing upstream latency field, 4) no fallback metric for model-variant throttles.
maya: For immediate stopgap instrumentation: I'm going to:
- enable route-level trace sampling 20% for keys `/v1/generate`, `/v1/embed`
- inject X-Request-Id into envoy access logs and upstream headers
- add a lightweight counter `gateway.request.timeout` to statsd from gateway; emit on timeout path
- enable `upstream_rq_time` in access logs to capture upstream timing

Patch snippet I pushed to ops repo:
```yaml
# envoy access log addition (hotpatch)
access_log:
  - name: envoy.file_access_log
    typed_config:
      '@type': type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.access_loggers.file.v3.FileAccessLog
      path: /var/log/envoy/access.log
      format: '%START_TIME% %REQ(:METHOD)% %REQ(X-REQUEST-ID)% %RESPONSE_CODE% %BYTES_SENT% %UPSTREAM_TRANSPORT_FAILURE_REASON% %UPSTREAM_RESPONSE_TIME%
'
```

ben: Good. Also add a short-lived metric `gateway.timeouts_5m` and create an alert runbook that points to this incident.
sophie: Alert rule modified. Pager suppression for known retries in client lib added to avoid noise.
ryan: After the patches, error rate dropped from 6% -> 0.9% over ~8 minutes. p99 latency trending down.
maya: Still seeing a small tail of 502s for long requests — probable backend model queuing. Plan: canary a config that reduces max tokens for heavy requests (server-side cap) and route long requests to dedicated pool.
ben: For next steps:
- short: keep increased tracing and access logs for 2 hours, collect data, notify CS with update in 30m
- medium: roll server-side request_id propagation fix into model backends and add fallback metrics
- long: change sampling policy to capture 100% traces that result in 5xx/timeout, and add SLI for missing trace rate

maya: I'll own medium and long follow-ups. Sophie will run the postmortem and assign owners for each observability gap.
sophie: acknowledged. I'll create postmortem doc and include timelines + list of stopgap patches.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED by sophie at 2026-03-14T09:42:30Z — Root cause: transient gateway concurrency/queueing + insufficient trace sampling. Mitigation: envoy hotpatch (request-id + access logs), trace sampling increase, stream limits, fallback routing.
ben: Thanks team :thumbsup: Good job moving quickly on stopgap instrumentation. We'll schedule a follow-up retro and an ops task for permanent fixes.
maya: Adding tickets now.
ryan: leaving monitoring watch. If error rate creeps back up I'll re-open the incident.
ops-bot: Incident summary uploaded: /incidents/1830005000-timeouts-hotpatch-summary.md
ben: closing thread here — ping if regressions.
